title: On a seven-vertex arc, the survivor pair vanishes together only at diagonals below 1/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1,2,3,4,5,6}`, the path entry from 1 to 2 has survivor roots `-569603/95904` and `-113633/16880`. No off-diagonal pivot entry has a root in `(0, 5/8]`.
- The positive common roots are the inner diagonals `4429/115952`, `8717/120240`, and `45349/602964`, each below `1/2`. At the center, both directions of `(7,8)` vanish and the complement is diagonal with norm `2196/2435`. Scaling that diagonal back to 1 makes the off-sum `301482/45349`.
- Selected κ is unchanged. A length-8 arc has one survivor and no off-diagonal pair. This does not decide Gaussian boundary order.
